constraints.name: Food Business Operator (FBO) status

citation.regulation: Regulation (EC) 852/2004 (retained UK law), Regulation (EC) 178/2002 (General Food Law)

constraints.rationale_summary: If HarvestLink takes possession or relabels food instead of just facilitating data/matching, it becomes an FBO with inspection duties.
constraints.mitigation_summary: Platform must operate strictly as a data/matching and documentation layer; producers and distributors remain the FBOs, never HarvestLink.
constraints.reasoning: Red label re-derived and confirmed: the naive design would trigger FBO status. The facilitation-only mitigation is precedented for UK marketplace platforms, so no legal-review flag is needed.

constraints.name: Traceability record integrity

citation.regulation: Regulation (EC) 178/2002, Article 18 (one step back, one step forward)

constraints.rationale_summary: Traceability records will be relied on by buyers and enforcement during a recall — integrity needs deliberate design, not assumption.
constraints.mitigation_summary: Require producer and distributor dual sign-off on every traceability record, with an immutable, append-only audit log.
constraints.reasoning: Amber confirmed: the requirement is well-defined and the dual-sign-off pattern is a standard technical mitigation, not a novel legal question.

constraints.name: Allergen declaration liability

citation.regulation: Food Information (Amendment) (England) Regulations 2019 ("Natasha's Law"); Food Information Regulations 2014 / EU FIC Regulation 1169/2011

constraints.rationale_summary: If HarvestLink auto-generates/edits an allergen declaration without producer attestation, liability could shift onto HarvestLink.
constraints.mitigation_summary: Allergen declarations must be producer-attested and signed off before finalising; HarvestLink is infrastructure, not the legal declarant.
constraints.reasoning: Amber confirmed against kb-L2-domain-regulatory: the liability-shifting risk and the producer-attestation mitigation are both grounded in the KB's stated facts.

constraints.name: Data protection
constraints.rationale_summary: Standard obligation for any platform handling producer and buyer business data; not a feasibility blocker on its own.
constraints.reasoning: Green confirmed: an ongoing design requirement common to any B2B platform, not specific or novel to HarvestLink's model.

overall_status.rationale_summary: CON-01 (FBO status) is Red but has a precedented facilitation-only mitigation, so status is discounted to Amber.
